experiment: XC-3 steering parity: one persona-steering protocol for GPT-2 Small and Gemma-2-2B
status: PRE-REGISTERED (frozen before any VALIDATION or TEST row is scored; smoke used TRAIN rows only)
evidence_level_on_completion: VALIDATION phase: validation finding (strength selection, descriptive controls). TEST phase: confirmed test result for H1-H3; H4 descriptive.
research_question: Does a reconstruction-derived (SAE) honesty direction keep the causal steering effect of the original-activation honesty direction, and is the answer the same for GPT-2 Small and Gemma-2-2B under one protocol?
why: Audit 2026-11-21 row 14: GPT-2 steering (RepE L6, 200 controls) and Gemma steering (GoT L11, 20 controls, no SAE) used different tasks, sites and control counts, so no cross-model steering comparison is valid. XC-3 runs one protocol on both models with >= 200 controls and adds the reconstruction-direction arm, which links steering to the SAE-faithfulness question (causal behaviour preserved through the SAE).
task: RepE-LM fit templates T1-T4, honest (H) vs untruthful (U) persona prompts, one-token swaps (K1 re-checked per model tokenizer; failing pairs dropped and counted). Neutral templates and T5-T8 are not used.

splits.train: data/repe/repe_lm/prompts.csv split=train: directions and alive SAE latents only (from cached final-token activations).
splits.validation: same file split=validation (89 statements x 4 templates): strength selection (argmax E_raw over GRID) and gate G1; descriptive Gaussian controls.
splits.test: data/repe/repe_lm_test/prompts.csv T1-T4 (86 statements x 4 templates): scored ONCE by --phase test with the frozen selection.json.

test_exposure_disclosure: GPT-2: RepE-LM TEST was read once on 2026-11-13 by the pre-registered H1-TEST pass (HT1-HT4: M4 causal preservation, pair-direction cosine, refit gap, probe transfer). No steering direction or strength of XC-3 was evaluated on it, and nothing in this protocol was chosen after seeing it, but the rows are NOT pristine for GPT-2. Gemma: RepE-LM TEST has never been run through Gemma.

models_sites.gemma: HF google/gemma-2-2b rev c5ebcd40 bf16 eager, output of model.model.layers[L] (resid_post), L = 5, 12, 19 (depth 0.23/0.50/0.77)

outcome: E(v) = 1 - sum_i KL(p_H,i || p_{U+v},i) / sum_i KL(p_H,i || p_U,i); p = next-token distribution at the final prompt token; higher is better (1 = honest-persona output recovered). Category: steering (causal intervention). Within-model normalised, so it is comparable across models.

arms.raw: u_raw = unit(mean_H - mean_U), ORIGINAL final-token activations, TRAIN, T1-T4
arms.rec: u_rec = unit(mean SAE(x_H) - mean SAE(x_U)), TRAIN; SAE = res-jb (GPT-2, 24576 latents) / Gemma Scope 16k canonical (Gemma, L0 68/82/73 at L5/12/19)
arms.patch: positive control: x_U <- x_H at the site and final token, per pair (unconstrained norm)

strength: s = c* x ||mean_H - mean_U||_TRAIN; c in [0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8] (= scripts/repe/13 grid); c* = argmax E_raw on VALIDATION per (model, layer). The same s for rec and all controls.
controls: at s: 200 Gaussian random unit directions (seed 20261123 / +1 for Gemma); 200 random single alive SAE decoder columns with random sign (alive = fires on >= 1 TRAIN H/U row). VALIDATION: Gaussian only (descriptive). TEST: both families.

gates.G1: E_patch bootstrap CI low > 0 on VALIDATION at the cell; a failing cell is reported as not eligible and its hypotheses are not tested.
gates.sanity: zero-edit max |KL diff| < 1e-6; Gemma final-token logit path equals the full forward (max |dlogp| < 1e-3)

hypotheses_test.H1: per eligible (model, layer): E_raw > Gaussian controls AND > SAE-feature controls, one-sided empirical p, Holm over the 6 cells within each control family, both < 0.05.
hypotheses_test.H2: per eligible cell: E_rec > Gaussian controls, Holm over 6 cells < 0.05.
hypotheses_test.H3: only where H1 holds: retention R = E_rec / E_raw with statement-clustered bootstrap 95% CI: PRESERVED if CI low >= 0.8; DEGRADED if CI high < 0.8; else INCONCLUSIVE.
hypotheses_test.H4_descriptive: cross-model parity per depth-matched pair (3/5, 6/12, 9/19): E_raw, E_rec, R and E_patch side by side; R_gemma - R_gpt2 with a bootstrap CI only where H1 holds in both models.

statistics: empirical p = (1 + #controls >= target)/(1 + n); bootstrap over statements (2000 resamples, numpy seed 0), clustering the 4 templates of a statement.
comparisons: raw vs Gaussian / SAE-feature controls: does the honesty direction steer specifically?
rec vs Gaussian: does the SAE-derived direction steer?
rec vs raw (R): is the causal steering effect preserved through the SAE?
GPT-2 vs Gemma at matched depth: parity of E_raw, R, E_patch (descriptive)
leakage: directions/latents from TRAIN only; strength from VALIDATION only; TEST read once after selection.json is written; evaluation is not a probe so no probe circularity; no SAE training.
deviations_from_audit_plan: The audit row said 'one protocol, both models'. The task chosen is RepE-LM persona (not GoT judgment) because both models pass its behaviour gates (K1, K7) and its outcome E is within-model normalised; GoT on Gemma is covered by XC-2.
multiplicity: Holm within each pre-registered family (H1-Gaussian, H1-SAE-feature, H2) over 6 cells.
test_data_used: VALIDATION phase: none. TEST phase: RepE-LM TEST T1-T4 once.
